notes.title: Patch Notes for version 0.3.2
notes.content:
[h2]# Patch Notes for version 0.3.2[/h2][p]
[b][i]warning[/i][/b]: old saves (from v [b]0.2..[/b]) will unfortunately be removed and challenge mode will be disabled [/p][h3][b]Features[/b]:  [/h3][list][*][p]added short tutorial / video instructions for new players in the main menu[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b]:  [/h3][list][*][p]improved hints - grayed out buildings that were not yet encountered [/p][/*][*][p]increased shadows distance[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]  [b]Fixes[/b]:  [/h3][list][*][p]fix misleading shadowed \\ sunlit hints[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for version 0.3.1
notes.content:
[h2]# Patch Notes for version 0.3.1[/h2][p]
[i][b]warning[/b][/i]: previous saves (from v 0.2..) will unfortunately be removed and challenge mode will be disabled
[/p][h3][b]Features[/b]:  [/h3][list][*][p]added WASD / arrow keys camera movement [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]TAB switches to main orbit camera instead of toggling between main orbit / targeted camera (and MMB / ` / WASD / arrow keys activate targeted camera) [/p][/*][*][p]added double LMB click on empty space to switch to main orbit camera [/p][/*][*][p]reworked resources / relations overlay for improved readability and performance [/p][/*][*][p]added orbit generator and orbital space station (still WIP, click on the generator to enter orbit placement mode, best to check out in the freebuild mode) [/p][/*][*][p]added trains connections (still WIP, click on the interactable spheres on the train pole or train station to enter train tracks placement, best to check out in the freebuild mode) [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b]:  [/h3][list][*][p]rewards balancing[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]added vfx and animations to buildings[/p][/*][*][p]added new skyboxes and other environment updates [/p][/*][*][p]additional feedback added when placing buildings [/p][/*][*][p]don't enable overview (idle) camera when placing buildings [/p][/*][*][p]any interaction turns off overview (idle) camera [/p][/*][*][p]added scrollbar to available buildings panel if list exceeds visible width[/p][/*][*][p]added animation for new buildings appearing in the available buildings panel [/p][/*][*][p]improved hints readability and split between buildings and other relations[/p][/*][*][p]improvements to placement / collisions handling of buildings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]  [b]Fixes[/b]:  [/h3][list][*][p]fix leaderboards sorting [/p][/*][*][p]fix clicking through available buildings panel [/p][/*][*][p]fix some environment configurations not appearing in the generator [/p][/*][*][p]fix selecting buildings from the list with keyboard 1-0 and <> not working properly with building filters[/p][/*][/list]
